# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly 14 to 15 years old during the novel's main events  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a heavy-set, plump girl. She possesses a somewhat spiteful and mocking expression, frequently smirking or throwing spiteful grins at others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is malicious, dishonest, and spiteful, often taking pleasure in the embarrassment or failure of her peers. She possesses a competitive, vindictive streak and holds grudges easily over small slights, such as losing desired roles or being held accountable for cheating. She is also prone to boasting and vanity regarding her own skills and financial standing, while harboring a lack of imagination and disdain for creative pursuits.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P10](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047)_

## Traits

- Malicious and spiteful  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>
- Dishonest and prone to cheating  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- Vain and boastful  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c25 P29](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0029)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skillful at walking wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>

## Goals

- To excel over her classmates and outdo her rivals  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- To gain an education without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flossie attends the Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. During a spelling exercise, she attempts to cheat by peeking at her textbook, but gets caught by Nell's contemptuous glare and misspells her word regardless. When Nell is punished by Mr. Pidgeon, Flossie grins at her humiliation. During a garden gathering at the Pembrokes', Flossie boasts of her fence-walking skills and dares Nell to walk the kitchen roof ridgepole, resulting in Nell falling and breaking her ankle. Later, when Nell returns to school, Flossie attempts to mock her, but her taunts are met with silent forgiveness. Flossie joins the Regent's entrance class, boasting that she attends school merely for an education as her father's wealth means she will not need to work. She competes in school recitations, though she expresses disdain for the events due to her lack of creative mind, and she becomes moody upon losing the role of Fairy Queen to Odette Pullen. After taking her entrance exams in Portmaris, she barely passes with a three-point margin. She subsequently attends Regent's Academy for a second year of study.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P12](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0012), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
